placement: Capability Pack — src/capabilities/adapters/ with its own contract unit. The application explicitly registers adapters (id and version); the engine mounts one into a named slot and drives it by an opaque instance id; the adapter speaks only through JSON facts. Every adapter call is fault-isolated and a faulted instance is quarantined. A generic Web Component adapter ships as a separately loaded module; a complex widget stub lives with the tests. Adapters run with page authority: the trust boundary is documented, not hidden. Core unchanged; absent unless registered.
